description: Find current offers PostThisDeal tracks that match a need and budget. Results are the best of the offers PostThisDeal tracks, not every store. Each carries its freshness (confirmed, due, overdue or not independently verified), a status block with the separate facts (verification: independent|merchant|none; freshness; availability; price: matched|changed|variable|unknown; publication), conditions and unknowns. Withdrawn offers are never returned. Give memberships to leave out prices the shopper cannot get.

memberships.description: Programmes the shopper holds: amazon_prime, walmart_plus, target_circle_360, target_circle_card, costco_member, sams_club, kohls_rewards, student, store_card. Omit if unknown.

query.description: What the shopper wants, in words that would appear in a product title.

retailer.description: Retailer slug, e.g. walmart, target, amazon.

verified_only.description: Only offers whose price was confirmed at the retailer.
